I have round 1 testing for contour education tomorrow. Please let me know what I should expect.  Hi Nicholas,

Congratulations on progressing to the next stage of the hiring process for the Senior Software Engineer position at Contour Education.

Please note, the assessments are due within 48 hours of this email being sent.

Part 1 – Technical Assessment - Click here to get started
This consists of a one-way video interview, which should take no more than 15 minutes to complete. It includes a short set of questions designed to help us better understand your experience, thought process, and approach.
At the end of the assessment, please ensure you enter your contact details using the same full name, email address, and phone number you used in your application.

Part 2 – Behavioural Assessments - Click here to complete
We also ask you to complete the Predictive Index Behavioural & Cognitive Assessments. which typically take 20-25 minutes total. This gives us insight into your natural working style and how you may complement the team and environment at Contour.

Once both assessments have been submitted, we’ll review your responses carefully and be in touch regarding next steps.

Should you have any questions in the meantime, please feel free to contact us at hr@contoureducation.com.au.

Thank you again for your time and interest. We appreciate the effort involved at this stage and look forward to learning more about you.

Thank you,
Kelly Ly 
People and Culture Team at Contour
contour.com.au | 1800 888 300 | hello@contoureducation.com.au
